issues: Clean. Note (not a defect): strict_json + internal-only recall means the recall step is unauditable from the output, as the author acknowledges.
Clean. Best-balanced NOTA policy of the strict_json set: explicit symmetric rule (pick only on absolute failure of a-d; do not avoid when genuinely correct).

STRICT-JSON LEAK RISK: the few-shot exemplars display a 'Razonamiento:' prose line immediately before the JSON. In a strict_json (no-visible-reasoning) variant the model is likely to imitate the pattern and emit reasoning text OUTSIDE the JSON, breaking the 3-key parse on the live API. The declared output contract is 3-key so mode_schema_consistent is technically true, but the demonstration undermines it.
GIFT injection label 'Contexto medico recuperado' is missing the accent (should be 'médico').
Both worked exemplars are clinically correct (band ligation first-line for variceal bleed; IBP+claritromicina+amoxicilina 10-14 d first-line H. pylori), which is good.
GIFT injection label 'Contexto medico recuperado' missing accent (should be 'médico').
NOTA guidance is intentionally minimal (CoT-only control); the single reminder is conditional and correct, not over-biasing.
Clean. Per-option verdadera/falsa (OR) / respaldada-no-respaldada vs {chunks} (GIFT) with explicit if-all-false-then-NOTA and symmetric guard; GIFT label correctly accented.

GIFT PLACEHOLDER DEFECT: {chunks} appears TWICE — inline as '...contexto médico recuperado ({chunks}) cuando sea relevante...' in the recall paragraph AND again in the terminal 'Contexto médico recuperado:\n{chunks}' injection block. Violates the 'once each' rule and will inject the entire retrieved context twice (once mid-sentence). Verified programmatically (chunks count = 2). OR form is unaffected and safe.
GIFT injection label 'Contexto medico recuperado' missing accent (should be 'médico').
GIFT places the {chunks}/{question} injection mid-prompt (before the reasoning scaffold) rather than at the end — allowed (each token appears once) and OR still ends with the required question block.
Self-critique names both failure modes (answer-absence and anchoring); acceptable balance, though a one-directional critique carries a mild over-abstention tilt the author flags.

NOTA OVER-PICK DEFECT: the decision rule forces 'Ninguna de las respuestas anteriores es correcta' whenever confidence is 'media' OR 'baja' ('...tu respuesta final debe ser Ninguna..., aunque esa opción te parezca la mejor disponible entre las cuatro'). This routes mere uncertainty — not genuine answer-absence — to the sentinel, so on Condition-A items with a correct-but-atypically-worded option the model is compelled to pick NOTA. Directly biases over-picking and will depress Condition-A accuracy; conflates 'retriever/uncertainty gap' with 'answer absent'.
GIFT injection label 'Contexto medico recuperado' missing accent (should be 'médico').

Minor NOTA wording: step 2 asks whether each option 'coincide EXACTAMENTE' with the reference fact, which could over-trigger the sentinel for correct-but-paraphrased options; the explicit step-3 symmetry clause ('ambos errores son igual de graves') largely mitigates this. GIFT label correctly accented; strong per-option grounding in {chunks}.

Clean. Stacked step-back recall + absolute per-option POE verdict + symmetric decision rule; GIFT grounds steps 1-2 in {chunks} with a guideline fallback; {chunks}/{question} once each; label correctly accented. Strongest, best-balanced of the cot_json set.
